outcome: 30-day readmission rates after vaginal and cesarean delivery
cohort: 243,409 patients admitted for vaginal delivery without complication or cesarean delivery without complication from 2005 to 2012
finding: Black and Hispanic women had significantly higher rates of 30-day readmission after both vaginal and cesarean delivery compared to white women, even after controlling for patient socioeconomic status, comorbidities, and payer.
mod_finding: Black women were twice as likely and Hispanic women 40-50% more likely to be readmitted within 30 days of vaginal or cesarean delivery compared with white women.
